_kindNote: CO Y KHONG gate truong `kind`. `kind` la NGUON DU LIEU, khong phai quy tac PMH:
banner / thuong  -> boc tu trang chi tiet (PDP)
brand_tab        -> boc tu card danh muc #o=3 (CONSTRAINTS 2.6 cong nhan la Ground Truth)
moi / moi-banner -> do enforce_domain_invariants() ghi de len
CONSTRAINTS.md khong he rang buoc `kind`. Rang buoc duy nhat o muc 2.1 la quan he
giua banner cam, choice va PMH - do la thu phai gate, va no nam o `rule` + `pmh`.
